summary: AZZ Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a fiscal 2027 Q1 cash dividend of $0.24/share, a 20% increase from the prior $0.20/share. The dividend is payable on July 30, 2026, to shareholders of record July 9, 2026. The Board authorized the dividend; no advisors were named. This is a routine capital return event (regular dividend), not a special situation. The filing includes a press release and inline XBRL. No risk-arb angle exists; watch for continued dividend policy as a signal of shareholder value commitment.
